# CSV summary

> **Note:** `shared/scale_factors.json` was not present in `shared/` when this summary was generated. The scaled means below are therefore expressed as the unscaled mean multiplied by the required per-column factor `f_<column>`. (Multiplying every value in a column by a constant multiplies its mean by that same constant.)

| File | Rows | Scaled mean: time | Scaled mean: temperature | Scaled mean: humidity | Scaled mean: pressure |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | `2 × f_time` | `21.88 × f_temperature` | `40.36 × f_humidity` | — |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | `1.5 × f_time` | `20.15 × f_temperature` | `45.525 × f_humidity` | — |
| `sensors_c.csv` | 6 | `2.5 × f_time` | — | — | `1012.5333333333 × f_pressure` |

The factor file is needed to replace these expressions with numeric scaled means.

Created `workspace/summary.md`.
